latin: Non possumus dicere quod de re precisissime sumpta aliquid praedicetur praedicatione proprie dicta.
translation: We cannot say that anything is predicated, in the properly so-called sense of predication, of a thing taken in its most precise sense.
translation_note: 'de re precisissime sumpta' rendered 'of a thing taken in its most precise sense'; 'praedicatione proprie dicta' as 'the properly so-called sense of predication', keeping Pico's technical distinction between predication proper and looser senses of the term.
